name_zh: 图季曼/克罗地亚建国：边境民族建国与民主转型
name_en: Tudjman/Croatian State-Building: Borderland Nation-Building & Democratic Transition
description_zh: 弗拉尼奥·图季曼 (1922-1999) 克罗地亚首任总统 (1990-1999)，领导克罗地亚从南斯拉夫独立、建国、战争防御到民主巩固。核心建国逻辑：历史合法性(中世纪王国/班诺维纳/游击战传统)→武装建国(1991-95 家园战争/武科瓦尔/风暴行动)→民主制度化(1990 宪法/多党制/人权/欧盟/北约路径)→和解重建( Erdut 协议/难民回返/区域合作)。体现 M170 边境民族建国——以"历史合法性+武装自卫+民主制度化+区域和解"四位一体，在南斯拉夫解体/大塞尔维亚威胁/国际制裁三重夹击下完成民族建国。
description_en: Franjo Tudjman (1922-1999) Croatia's first President (1990-1999), led Croatia from Yugoslav independence through state-building, war defense to democratic consolidation. Core nation-building logic: historical legitimacy (medieval kingdom/Banovina/partisan tradition) -> armed state-building (1991-95 Homeland War/Vukovar/Operation Storm) -> democratic institutionalization (1990 Constitution/multi-party/human rights/EU/NATO path) -> reconciliation & reconstruction (Erdut Agreement/refugee return/regional cooperation). Exemplifies M170 Borderland Nation-Building—quaternity of 'historical legitimacy + armed self-defense + democratic institutionalization + regional reconciliation' achieving nation-building under triple squeeze of Yugoslav dissolution/Greater Serbian threat/international sanctions.
reason_zh: 克罗地亚建国是"历史合法性+武装自卫+民主转型"三位一体：图季曼以历史学家身份重构民族叙事，以将军身份指挥家园战争，以政治家身份推动民主/欧盟/北约。M170 区隔于 M181 边境地带共同体(历史)、M170 部落联邦(伊拉克)、M173 哈希姆守护(约旦)，核心在于"历史重构+武装建国+民主锚定"的后南斯拉夫建国范式。
reason_en: Croatian nation-building is trinity of 'historical legitimacy + armed self-defense + democratic transition': Tudjman as historian reconstructed national narrative, as general commanded Homeland War, as statesman drove democratic/EU/NATO anchoring. M170 distinct from M181 Borderland Commonwealth (historical), M170 Tribal Federalism (Iraq), M173 Hashemite Guardian (Jordan), core: 'historical reconstruction + armed state-building + democratic anchoring' post-Yugoslav nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 历史合法性重构：图季曼《民族主义与共产主义》重述克族历史，确立中世纪王国/班诺维纳/游击战三重合法性来源
武装建国与家园战争：1991 独立公投/武科瓦尔围城/1995 风暴行动收复克拉伊纳，武装自卫成建国核心
民主制度化与西向锚定：1990 宪法/多党制/人权/1992 国际承认/2000 EU 稳定与伙伴关系/2009 北约/2013 欧盟入盟
和解重建与区域合作：1995 Erdut 协议东斯拉沃尼亚和平重归/难民回返/区域合作(阿得里亚-离子倡议/三海倡议)
历史争议与遗产：雅谢诺瓦茨/乌斯塔沙/游击战双重叙事/战争罪指控/历史修正主义争议，遗产复杂
steps_en: Historical legitimacy reconstruction: Tudjman's 'Nationalism & Communism' re-narrates Croat history, establishing medieval kingdom/Banovina/partisan triple legitimacy sources
Armed state-building & Homeland War: 1991 independence referendum/Vukovar siege/1995 Operation Storm recaptures Krajina, armed self-defense as nation-building core
Democratic institutionalization & Western anchoring: 1990 Constitution/multi-party/human rights/1992 international recognition/2000 EU SAA/2009 NATO/2013 EU accession
Reconciliation, reconstruction & regional cooperation: 1995 Erdut Agreement Eastern Slavonia peaceful reintegration/refugee return/regional cooperation (Adriatic-Ionian/Three Seas Initiative)
Historical controversies & legacy: Jasenovac/Ustasa/partisan dual narratives/war crimes accusations/historical revisionism debates, complex legacy
expected_zh: 以"历史重构+武装建国+民主锚定+区域和解"四位一体，在大塞尔维亚威胁/国际制裁/内部寡头三重夹击下完成民族建国与民主转型，为后南斯拉夫空间提供建国范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'historical reconstruction + armed state-building + democratic anchoring + regional reconciliation' achieves nation-building & democratic transition under triple squeeze of Greater Serbian threat/international sanctions/internal oligarchs, providing nation-building paradigm for post-Yugoslav space.
case_zh: 1990 首任总统→1991 独立/武科瓦尔→1995 风暴行动/Erdut→1999 图季曼逝世→2000 拉奇奇/梅西奇民主巩固→2009 北约→2013 欧盟，三十年建国-战争-民主-入盟完整路径。
case_en: 1990 1st President -> 1991 independence/Vukovar -> 1995 Storm/Erdut -> 1999 Tudjman death -> 2000 Racan/Mesic democratic consolidation -> 2009 NATO -> 2013 EU, 30-year complete path of state-building-war-democracy-accession.
cross_cultural_impact: Post-Yugoslav nation-building model; Catholic Atlanticism; historical narrative politics; regional cooperation

diaspora_influence: Croatian diaspora 4M+ (US/CA/DE/AU/AR/CL); 1990s lobbying crucial for recognition
